title: PSball's Plant Hybrids
description: Lets you breed plants in the crafting table.
body:
--Description--
This mod lets you breed plants to make them better like tastes, or just more desirable like different colors or different heights. You can also make them worse, but I won't spoil which one. It adds achievements for breeding certain plants, and you can even cross-breed two different species of plants. One such hybrid gives you a whole hunger bar and lots of saturation, but again, I won't spoil which one. Most of the plants in the mod are bred from plants that aren't in vanilla Minecraft, but that's subject to change.

--Reading the Update Logs--
+Means that something new was added
-Means that something was removed
*Means that a glitch was fixed
/Means that something development-related was added that doesn't affect gameplay
^Means that something that somehow doesn't fit into the above categories was added

--Breeding paths--
- Apples
  - Color
  - Flavor
- Blueberries
  - Color
  - Flavor
- Pansies
  - Color
- Ghostflowers
  - Shape
- Roses
  - Color
  - Adding more colors
- Huckleberry
  - None, but can be bred with blueberries to create Ametrineberries
- Ametrineberries
  - None
- Tomato
  - None, but can be bred with potatoes to create Totatoes
- Potato
  - Removing poison
  - Can be bred with tomatoes to create Totatoes
- Totato
  - None
- Corn
  - Creating Maze (a plant you can use to make corn mazes
  - Creating soy beans
- Soy beans
  - None
- Cotton
  - Color
